$description: Canonical apparent design tokens. Functional state colors and the core-plus-pattern chart system are approved. Charts introduce no additional categorical hues.

paper.$description: Default canvas, reading surface, and neutral control field.

stock.$description: Grouped surface, table header, and quiet data region.

carbon.$description: Primary ink, rules, and inverse structural fields.

lilac.$description: Selected region, review-attention field, and secondary series.

signal.$description: Primary action, focus, active route, and one decisive data highlight.

onDark.$description: Text and icons on Carbon, Signal, or dark semantic status fields.

onWarning.$description: Carbon text and icons on warning gold. Paper text is prohibited on warning gold.

success.$description: Completed, confirmed, delivered, or healthy state. Always pair with a written label and icon or shape.

failure.$description: Failed, unavailable, invalid, blocked, or action-required outcome. Always pair with a written label and icon or shape.

inProgress.$description: Processing, retrying, queued, or otherwise incomplete state. This deliberately aliases Signal and must remain labeled.

warning.$description: Preventive caution before a failure. Use Carbon text on gold and pair with a written label and warning icon.

destructive.$description: Destructive action. This deliberately aliases failure red but remains a separate semantic role and requires confirmation.

disabled.$description: Neutral disabled-control treatment derived from Carbon. Apply the approved disabled opacity only to disabled controls and never introduce a disabled hue.

statusDisabled.$description: Reduced-emphasis Carbon treatment for disabled controls and labels. Disabled reason and state must remain understandable without color.

switchOffTrack.$description: Functional neutral for available Off switches only; not disabled or a general brand color.

switchLightThumb.$description: White circular switch thumb in both states; retain a Carbon edge.

switchDarkThumb.$description: White circular switch thumb in both states; retain a Carbon edge.
